description: This file defines a utility for creating and configuring an NWBrowser instance for service discovery using Bonjour/mDNS in a Swift project. It includes a public enumeration 'GatewayDiscoveryBrowserSupport' with a static method 'makeBrowser' that sets up the network browser with specific parameters, handlers, and threading context.

methods.name: makeBrowser
methods.description: Creates and configures an NWBrowser instance for Bonjour service discovery with specified parameters, state, and results handlers, running handlers on the main actor.
